kolekcje.nie_znaleziono_kolekcji_albo_jest: Collection not found or it's private.

1.realizm: Three points for 3.5 hours. A fourth could fit, but the amphitheater and walls involve many stairs for one afternoon.

2.realizm: A day with two car rides. Golem and the park are 6 minutes apart, so the order matters.

3.realizm: The museum closes at 4 PM — this is the only point of the day with a hard limit. The rest is flexible.

aplikacja.odpowiedz: The browser version works on your phone now. iOS and Android apps, with offline map downloads, are in preparation.

poza_europa.odpowiedz: Yes. The planner is global, the interface is available in several languages, and distances and times are calculated using local transport.

przeciazenie.odpowiedz: On the contrary – when the plan becomes unrealistic, it tells you directly and suggests what to move. You can set your own limit, for example, a maximum of four hours a day.
przeciazenie.pytanie: Will the agent not cram too much into one day?

zrodla.odpowiedz: From open databases of attractions, traveler reviews, and boards published by users. Opening hours and visiting times are verified before being shown in the feed.
zrodla.pytanie: Where do the places come from?

hero.opis: Search for attractions and add them to your trip board — "definitely", "maybe", "no". The agent creates a daily plan with realistic times and travel durations, and provides a ready-to-use GPX file for your watch or navigation device.
hero.tytul: Collect places. The agent will arrange the rest.
hero.zapewnienia: No card required · plan ready in minutes · also works offline in the field

mapy.opis: Organic Maps, Komoot, Gaia, Locus. The file opens without conversion.

nawigacja.opis: Built-in point-to-point guidance, with times from the plan. The map downloads before departure and works offline.

zegarek.opis: Garmin, Suunto, Coros, Wahoo – standard GPX with waypoints and track.

01.opis: City, dates, and trip vibe. The agent immediately suggests initial places, including those you hadn't considered.
01.tytul: Tell us where and with whom

02.opis: An attractions feed with photos, visiting times, and opening hours. One click adds a place to your board.

03.opis: The board has three buckets: definite, maybe, no. Rejected items don't disappear – you can always restore them.

04.opis: A daily plan with times, order, and travel duration. Finally, a GPX file for your watch or navigation.

legal.jezyk_wiazacy: This document is provided in English, and only the English version is binding. Translations of other content on the website are for reference only; in case of discrepancies, the English text shall prevail.

plan.bez_terminu: The trip has no dates — without one, the plan starts today. You can set dates in trip settings.
plan.cena_trasy: The first route for a day costs {{koszt}}. Recalculations for that day and the GPX file are free.
plan.co_dalej_opis: The walking route between the day’s stops, saved as a GPX file — open it on a watch, a navigation device or an offline map app.
plan.dialog_opis: The agent will build a {{dni}} plan from the places on your board. Earlier versions stay.
plan.gpx_opis: The file contains the route and the day’s named stops.
plan.gpx_wyjazdu: Download GPX for the whole trip
plan.gpx_wyjazdu_brak: Measure the route for at least one day to download the whole-trip file.
plan.gpx_wyjazdu_ile: {{ile}} of {{wszystkie}} days have a route — each as a separate track.
plan.kolacja_opis: Optional — the agent will put a specific nearby place at that time.
plan.koniec_po_oknie: The day ends at {{koniec}} — {{minuty}} min after the {{okno}} window.
plan.opis: A {{dni}} plan built from {{miejsca}} on your board{{termin}}. Check each day, move or remove what does not fit, then turn it into a route you can navigate.
plan.po_drodze_aktywne: Click on the map where you want to go. Click a point to remove it.
plan.przeniesiono_przesuniecie: Moved “{{nazwa}}” to day {{nr}}, {{godzina}} — later stops that day shifted by {{minuty}} min.
plan.trasa_blad: I could not measure this day’s route — try again.
plan.trasa_do_ponowienia: The measured route for this day needs to be measured again.
plan.trasa_oplacona: Day {{nr}} route ready — {{koszt}} charged. Further recalculations for this day are free.
plan.trasa_przelicza_sie: This day’s route will recalculate by itself, free of charge.
plan.wersje_opis: Each run saves a new version — earlier ones stay until you delete them.
plan.za_malo_punktow: This day has too few points on the map to measure a route.
plan.za_malo_tokenow: You have {{saldo}}, and building a plan costs {{cena}}.
plan.zapis_nieudany: I could not save the change — after a refresh the previous layout will come back.
